scope: Commercial claims, support channel and policy facts required before accepting payment

Whether displayed prices include applicable taxes, who issues invoices/receipts and what business/tax details appear on them.
Founder-approved rules for cancellation, duplicate/failed charges, refunds, processing timing and plan deactivation.
Effective date and legally reviewed governing-law/dispute wording, if used.
Customer-facing Razorpay/statement descriptor and merchant identity must match the approved operator.
